name: sectortrace-frontend
description: Phase 6 frontend workspace: two INDEPENDENT Nuxt 4 applications (public evidence atlas, admin operations control room). Each app has its own dependency graph, lockfile, and build; this root only orchestrates them. Node is a build-time dependency only — the production Python image never runs Node or Nitro.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix public ci || npm --prefix public install; npm --prefix admin ci || npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix public run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run budgets
scripts.clean: rm -rf public/.nuxt public/.output public/dist admin/.nuxt admin/.output admin/dist
